MATCH (river1)-[:partOf]->(basin)

MATCH (river2:River)-[:flowsThrough]->(other)

  , "rationale": "The query first identifies all drainage basins that are located in Spain (i.e., have at least one river flowing through Spain and belonging to the basin). }

}
